+# G221 prelaunch host inventory
+
+This is one observation of the existing selected-host contract before protected
+publication. Its owner is the unchanged `qualification/dg16-r5-full-g2/run.py`
+`inventory(u)` entry point, with `u = load_utility()`. The need is RUNBOOK F5 and
+step 22 in `handoff/dg16-g221-root-execution-inputs/RUNBOOK.md`: the current
+selected image and host must be applicable before a protected G221 publication.
+
+## Scope and result
+
+The wrapper loads the original adapter as a module. It never invokes its CLI,
+episode `execute`, provisioning, `observe_host`, protected preflight, request
+validation, banks, native tests, M5, model turns, or receiving. It creates no
+request, adoption, recipient, product checkout, or episode state. It performs no
+installation or repair. Credentials are the public numeric real/effective/saved
+UID/GID tuple returned by the original `getresuid/getresgid` reader; no credential
+store or key is read. The original `trusted('bwrap')` reads the binary and custody
+metadata; it does not execute it.
+
+All eight modules in the adapter's inventory import closure are pinned before
+owner code execution. `run.py` executes from checked held bytes. Its unchanged
+loaders hash the held bytes they compile; `load_native` also performs closing
+reads. The wrapper closes every held source member after the observation. The
+workflow pins and executes held observer bytes using `/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B`.
+The wrapper rejects selected process/network and filesystem mutation audit
+events while importing/calling the owner code. This narrow check supplements
+the inspected, pinned call graph; it is not a general sandbox.
+
+The workflow has one exact engineering branch push trigger, expected repository,
+created/nondeleted branch guards, attempt 1, `contents: read`, and no persisted
+checkout credentials. It uses the same pinned checkout/upload actions as the
+original workflow. It has one source checkout and no source publication step.
+
+The complete actual host passes through unchanged `current_host.target_host`.
+Canonical equality uses unchanged `evidence_io.encode` against
+`current_host.SELECTED_HOSTS`. A match exits 0 with
+`SELECTED_TUPLE_MATCH_OBSERVED`; its scope remains a prelaunch observation.
+A mismatch or unsupported inventory exits nonzero with the first original
+refusal. When inventory refuses before returning, `host`, `selected_tuple`, and
+`selected_match` remain null. No partial or invented host is substituted.
+
+Every result explicitly leaves same-job earned qualification, currentness,
+future G221 acceptance, and effect grants false. A later protected job still
+needs its original checks on its own actual host. These artifact/log bytes are
+observations and confer no authority.
+
+## Public transport
+
+`OBSERVATION.json` contains canonical ASCII JSON with sorted keys, compact
+separators, and one final LF. `OBSERVATION.sha256` binds those exact bytes.
+Source rows give repository-relative paths, byte counts, SHA-256 and Git blob
+identities. The source-base commit/tree describe the unchanged owners; the
+provider SHA identifies the workflow event and is independently checked when
+receiving provider evidence. This wrapper does not claim provider authentication.
+
+The only retained provider environment identifiers are repository, ref, SHA,
+run ID, attempt, and event. Invalid/missing values are null. There is no general
+environment dump. The artifact upload runs with `always()`, including failure.
+An observer bootstrap pin failure emits a separate explicit refusal schema and
+exits nonzero. Checkout failure or runner loss can prevent any observation from
+being produced; upload then fails on missing files and does not imply success.
+
+The exact body is also a single log line:
+
+```text
+DG16_G221_HOST_INVENTORY sha256=<64 lowercase hex> base64=<canonical bytes including LF>
+```
+
+An independent receiver can decode that line from the GitHub log API, require
+canonical encoding and matching SHA-256, then reconcile artifact bytes and
+provider run/commit identity. No receiving or acceptance machinery is added here.
+
+## Focused local qualification
+
+```bash
+/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B qualification/dg16-g221-host-inventory/test_observe.py
+/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B qualification/dg16-g221-host-inventory/observe.py --local --output <fresh-declared-evidence-directory>
+```
+
+The tests check the new closure, inert imports, direct owner call boundaries,
+source-change refusal, provider guards, environment allowlist, effect filter,
+safe error reporting, workflow pins and bootstrap syntax. Synthetic validator
+inputs are marked `TEST_ONLY` and never installed as provider/host evidence.
+No test constructs a selected-host success. `--local` is a real read-only host
+observation with an explicit unhosted context and always exits nonzero. Its
+expected first refusal on a different host must remain visible.
+
+Rollback is removal of these new observation-only sources before publication.
+No previously accepted suite or owner source is changed or rerun by this work.

+import argparse
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import stat
+import sys
+import types
+
+REPOSITORY = 'theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md'
+BRANCH = 'engineering/pro-executor-g221-host-inventory-20261115'
+BASE_COMMIT = '060902121a45b180853e630891caa5e6c9d2f704'
+BASE_TREE = 'f74f43a029cca69dc28af9096e983c9e275f3436'
+OWNER = 'qualification/dg16-r5-full-g2/'
+WORKFLOW = '.github/workflows/dg16-g221-host-inventory.yml'
+PINS = {
+    'run.py': '688166071f33d2cb33c48a4136a88b7dccf719267e9fa43db72cffb361fdbd74',
+    'host_utility.py': '02a15dc96ecce23e14a3a84bca880aa536d79fffc4f6d6160835cb4ba97a19b5',
+    'evidence_io.py': 'c2f8d718c8acd3a223d494239e6bc19d4a90e3d5c66f49cdac8f701ce4807075',
+    'native_profile.py': 'c16c75039b938718ab4bfee9e49a6c55322bdfda22f25d0a526cf74f87944c3d',
+    'native_admission.py': 'd96262b67a18f62a7fe07264a3b5a08b5a8016a237d9b46ca7c781e234421342',
+    'current_host.py': '893ad0f5c8b59d7bff47985cfe94ef8d76d5b1cbb76f4076c1efdf86fe10d3fc',
+    'native_prerequisite.py': '594ac753bbfda9cfa3285a7c5a31018fd5384bb3d3f0afcd89bc29cea7749f42',
+    'native_integration.py': 'c6f2b17e59369a04db2062b79ea2150c54d978fd1c0f18a9b25e094e303bc266',
+}
+PROVIDER = {
+    'repository': ('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}'),
+    'ref': ('GITHUB_REF', r'refs/heads/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,200}'),
+    'sha': ('GITHUB_SHA', r'[0-9a-f]{40}'),
+    'run_id': ('GITHUB_RUN_ID', r'[1-9][0-9]{0,19}'),
+    'attempt': ('GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT', r'[1-9][0-9]{0,5}'),
+    'event': ('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME', r'[a-z_]{1,40}'),
+}
+PREFIX = 'DG16_G221_HOST_INVENTORY '
+
+
+class Refusal(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def need(value, code):
+    if not value:
+        raise Refusal(code)
+
+
+def canonical(value):
+    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
+                       ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('ascii')
+
+
+def descriptor(raw):
+    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
+                git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest())
+
+
+def read_file(path):
+    """Bounded ordinary-file read; execute only the bytes checked by the caller."""
+    before = path.lstat()
+    need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1
+         and before.st_size <= 256 * 1024, 'SOURCE_FILE_SHAPE_REFUSED')
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC)
+    try:
+        stamp = lambda s: (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_size, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)
+        need(stamp(os.fstat(fd)) == stamp(before), 'SOURCE_OPEN_CHANGED')
+        with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb', closefd=False) as stream:
+            raw = stream.read(256 * 1024 + 1)
+        need(len(raw) == before.st_size and stamp(os.fstat(fd)) == stamp(before)
+             and stamp(path.lstat()) == stamp(before), 'SOURCE_READ_CHANGED')
+        return raw
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+
+
+def verify_pin(name, raw):
+    need(descriptor(raw)['sha256'] == PINS[name], 'OWNER_SOURCE_PIN_REFUSED')
+
+
+def provider_fields(environment):
+    # Invalid/missing values become null; arbitrary environment text is never logged.
+    return {key: value if re.fullmatch(pattern, value) else None
+            for key, (name, pattern) in PROVIDER.items()
+            for value in (environment.get(name, ''),)}
+
+
+def require_provider(provider, environment):
+    need(all(value is not None for value in provider.values())
+         and provider['repository'] == REPOSITORY
+         and provider['ref'] == 'refs/heads/' + BRANCH
+         and provider['event'] == 'push' and provider['attempt'] == '1'
+         and environment.get('GITHUB_ACTIONS') == 'true'
+         and environment.get('G221_PUSH_CREATED') == 'true'
+         and environment.get('G221_PUSH_DELETED') == 'false', 'PROVIDER_CONTEXT_REFUSED')
+
+
+def effect_denied(event, args):
+    if event == 'open':
+        mode, flags = args[1:3]
+        return bool((isinstance(mode, str) and any(c in mode for c in 'wax+'))
+                    or (isinstance(flags, int) and flags & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND)))
+    return (event.startswith(('subprocess.', 'socket.', 'os.exec', 'os.spawn', 'os.posix_spawn', 'os.fork'))
+            or event in {'os.system', 'os.mkdir', 'os.remove', 'os.rmdir', 'os.rename',
+                         'os.link', 'os.symlink', 'os.chmod', 'os.chown', 'os.truncate',
+                         'os.utime', 'os.setxattr', 'os.removexattr', 'os.chdir', 'os.putenv', 'os.unsetenv'})
+
+
+def failure(exc, stage):
+    # Owner refusal codes are fixed public tokens. Never print exception messages/paths.
+    message = str(exc)
+    code = message if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}', message) else 'OBSERVATION_EXCEPTION_REFUSED'
+    return dict(stage=stage, code=code, exception=type(exc).__name__,
+                errno=exc.errno if isinstance(exc, OSError) else None)
+
+
+def observe(local=False):
+    root = Path(__file__).absolute().parents[2]
+    provider = provider_fields(os.environ)
+    result = dict(schema='dg16.g221-prelaunch-host-inventory.v1', authority='NONE',
+        scope='PRELAUNCH_OBSERVATION_ONLY', context='LOCAL_UNHOSTED' if local else 'GITHUB_HOSTED',
+        status='REFUSED', provider=provider, source_base_commit=BASE_COMMIT, source_base_tree=BASE_TREE,
+        sources={}, source_closing_verified=False, host=None, tool_paths=None,
+        selected_tuple=None, selected_tuple_sha256=None, selected_candidates_sha256=None,
+        selected_match=None, first_refusal=None, closing_refusal=None,
+        same_job_earned_qualification=False, currentness=False,
+        future_g221_acceptance=False, effect_grant=False)
+    held = {}
+    active = [False]
+
+    def audit(event, args):
+        if active[0] and effect_denied(event, args):
+            raise Refusal('OBSERVATION_EFFECT_REFUSED')
+
+    sys.addaudithook(audit)
+    stage = 'SOURCE'
+    try:
+        need(root.resolve(strict=True) == root, 'SOURCE_ROOT_ALIAS_REFUSED')
+        need(sys.flags.isolated and sys.flags.no_site and sys.dont_write_bytecode,
+             'ISOLATED_SYSTEM_PYTHON_REQUIRED')
+        for relative in ('qualification/dg16-g221-host-inventory/observe.py', WORKFLOW):
+            held[relative] = read_file(root / relative)
+            result['sources'][relative] = descriptor(held[relative])
+        if not local:
+            need(globals().get('_HELD_OBSERVER_BYTES') == held['qualification/dg16-g221-host-inventory/observe.py'],
+                 'HELD_OBSERVER_REQUIRED')
+            stage = 'PROVIDER'
+            require_provider(provider, os.environ)
+        stage = 'OWNER_SOURCE'
+        for name in PINS:
+            relative = OWNER + name
+            raw = read_file(root / relative)
+            result['sources'][relative] = dict(descriptor(raw), expected_sha256=PINS[name])
+            verify_pin(name, raw)
+            held[relative] = raw
+        # All eight owner modules are pinned before any owner module is executed.
+        # Original loaders also hash their held compile bytes and close native reads.
+        stage = 'MODULE_LOAD'
+        active[0] = True
+        adapter = types.ModuleType('g221_observation_adapter')
+        adapter.__file__ = str(root / OWNER / 'run.py')
+        exec(compile(held[OWNER + 'run.py'], adapter.__file__, 'exec'), adapter.__dict__)
+        utility = adapter.load_utility()
+        native = adapter.load_native(utility)  # Inert module construction, not admission.
+        result['selected_candidates_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(native.E.encode(list(native.C.SELECTED_HOSTS))).hexdigest()
+        stage = 'INVENTORY'
+        paths, host = adapter.inventory(utility)
+        result['host'], result['tool_paths'] = host, paths
+        stage = 'SELECTED_TUPLE'
+        selected = native.C.target_host(host)
+        selected_raw = native.E.encode(selected)
+        result['selected_tuple'] = selected
+        result['selected_tuple_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(selected_raw).hexdigest()
+        result['selected_match'] = any(selected_raw == native.E.encode(candidate)
+                                       for candidate in native.C.SELECTED_HOSTS)
+        need(result['selected_match'], 'G2_CURRENT_HOST_SELECTED_TUPLE_REFUSED')
+        need(not local, 'LOCAL_OBSERVATION_HAS_NO_HOSTED_CONTEXT')
+        result['status'] = 'SELECTED_TUPLE_MATCH_OBSERVED'
+    except Exception as exc:
+        result['first_refusal'] = failure(exc, stage)
+    finally:
+        active[0] = False
+        try:
+            for relative, raw in held.items():
+                need(read_file(root / relative) == raw, 'SOURCE_CLOSING_CHANGED')
+            result['source_closing_verified'] = len(held) == len(PINS) + 2
+        except Exception as exc:
+            result['closing_refusal'] = failure(exc, 'SOURCE_CLOSING')
+            if result['first_refusal'] is None:
+                result['first_refusal'] = result['closing_refusal']
+            result['status'] = 'REFUSED'
+    return result
+
+
+def emit(result, output):
+    raw = canonical(result)
+    need(len(raw) <= 64 * 1024, 'PUBLIC_OBSERVATION_BOUND')
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    # This exact canonical body (including final LF) is independently recoverable.
+    print(PREFIX + 'sha256=' + digest + ' base64=' + base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'), flush=True)
+    output = output.absolute()
+    need(output.parent.resolve(strict=True) == output.parent, 'OUTPUT_PARENT_ALIAS_REFUSED')
+    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)  # Fresh output only; never overwrite earlier evidence.
+    for name, body in (('OBSERVATION.json', raw), ('OBSERVATION.sha256', (digest + '  OBSERVATION.json\n').encode('ascii'))):
+        with (output / name).open('xb') as stream:
+            stream.write(body)
+        need((output / name).read_bytes() == body, 'OUTPUT_READBACK_REFUSED')
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--local', action='store_true', help='Unhosted read-only diagnostic; always exits nonzero.')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    result = observe(args.local)
+    try:
+        emit(result, args.output)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print('DG16_G221_HOST_INVENTORY_RETENTION_REFUSED ' + canonical(failure(exc, 'RETENTION')).decode().strip(), flush=True)
+        return 1
+    return 0 if result['status'] == 'SELECTED_TUPLE_MATCH_OBSERVED' else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+# G221 prelaunch host inventory
+
+This is one observation of the existing selected-host contract before protected
+publication. Its owner is the unchanged `qualification/dg16-r5-full-g2/run.py`
+`inventory(u)` entry point, with `u = load_utility()`. The need is RUNBOOK F5 and
+step 22 in `handoff/dg16-g221-root-execution-inputs/RUNBOOK.md`: the current
+selected image and host must be applicable before a protected G221 publication.
+
+## Scope and result
+
+The wrapper loads the original adapter as a module. It never invokes its CLI,
+episode `execute`, provisioning, `observe_host`, protected preflight, request
+validation, banks, native tests, M5, model turns, or receiving. It creates no
+request, adoption, recipient, product checkout, or episode state. It performs no
+installation or repair. Credentials are the public numeric real/effective/saved
+UID/GID tuple returned by the original `getresuid/getresgid` reader; no credential
+store or key is read. The original `trusted('bwrap')` reads the binary and custody
+metadata; it does not execute it.
+
+All eight modules in the adapter's inventory import closure are pinned before
+owner code execution. `run.py` executes from checked held bytes. Its unchanged
+loaders hash the held bytes they compile; `load_native` also performs closing
+reads. The wrapper closes every held source member after the observation. The
+workflow pins and executes held observer bytes using `/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B`.
+The wrapper rejects selected process/network and filesystem mutation audit
+events while importing/calling the owner code. This narrow check supplements
+the inspected, pinned call graph; it is not a general sandbox.
+
+The workflow has one exact engineering branch push trigger, expected repository,
+created/nondeleted branch guards, attempt 1, `contents: read`, and no persisted
+checkout credentials. It uses the same pinned checkout/upload actions as the
+original workflow. It has one source checkout and no source publication step.
+
+The complete actual host passes through unchanged `current_host.target_host`.
+Canonical equality uses unchanged `evidence_io.encode` against
+`current_host.SELECTED_HOSTS`. A match exits 0 with
+`SELECTED_TUPLE_MATCH_OBSERVED`; its scope remains a prelaunch observation.
+A mismatch or unsupported inventory exits nonzero with the first original
+refusal. When inventory refuses before returning, `host`, `selected_tuple`, and
+`selected_match` remain null. No partial or invented host is substituted.
+
+Every result explicitly leaves same-job earned qualification, currentness,
+future G221 acceptance, and effect grants false. A later protected job still
+needs its original checks on its own actual host. These artifact/log bytes are
+observations and confer no authority.
+
+## Public transport
+
+`OBSERVATION.json` contains canonical ASCII JSON with sorted keys, compact
+separators, and one final LF. `OBSERVATION.sha256` binds those exact bytes.
+Source rows give repository-relative paths, byte counts, SHA-256 and Git blob
+identities. The source-base commit/tree describe the unchanged owners; the
+provider SHA identifies the workflow event and is independently checked when
+receiving provider evidence. This wrapper does not claim provider authentication.
+
+The only retained provider environment identifiers are repository, ref, SHA,
+run ID, attempt, and event. Invalid/missing values are null. There is no general
+environment dump. The artifact upload runs with `always()`, including failure.
+An observer bootstrap pin failure emits a separate explicit refusal schema and
+exits nonzero. Checkout failure or runner loss can prevent any observation from
+being produced; upload then fails on missing files and does not imply success.
+
+The exact body is also a single log line:

+```text
+DG16_G221_HOST_INVENTORY sha256=<64 lowercase hex> base64=<canonical bytes including LF>
+```

+An independent receiver can decode that line from the GitHub log API, require

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Narrow new-wrapper controls. Synthetic inputs are TEST_ONLY, never host evidence."""
+import ast
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import textwrap
+import types
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).absolute().parents[2]
+PATH = ROOT / 'qualification/dg16-g221-host-inventory/observe.py'
+OBS = types.ModuleType('TEST_ONLY_observer')
+OBS.__file__ = str(PATH)
+exec(compile(PATH.read_bytes(), str(PATH), 'exec'), OBS.__dict__)
+
+
+class Controls(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_exact_owner_closure_and_internal_loader_pins(self):
+        self.assertEqual(len(OBS.PINS), 8)
+        raw = (ROOT / OBS.OWNER / 'run.py').read_bytes()
+        constants = {n.targets[0].id: n.value.value for n in ast.parse(raw).body
+                     if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
+                     and isinstance(n.value, ast.Constant)}
+        names = {'host_utility.py': 'UTILITY_SHA', 'evidence_io.py': 'NATIVE_EVIDENCE_IO_SHA',
+                 'native_profile.py': 'NATIVE_PROFILE_SHA', 'native_admission.py': 'NATIVE_ADMISSION_SHA',
+                 'current_host.py': 'CURRENT_HOST_SHA', 'native_prerequisite.py': 'NATIVE_RECEIVER_SHA',
+                 'native_integration.py': 'NATIVE_INTEGRATION_SHA'}
+        for name, pin in OBS.PINS.items():
+            OBS.verify_pin(name, (ROOT / OBS.OWNER / name).read_bytes())
+            if name in names:
+                self.assertEqual(constants[names[name]], pin)
+
+    def test_owner_imports_are_inert_and_stdlib_only(self):
+        allowed_imports = {'argparse', 'ctypes', 'errno', 'fcntl', 'hashlib', 'json', 'os', 'pathlib',
+                           're', 'selectors', 'signal', 'socket', 'stat', 'subprocess', 'sys', 'time', 'types'}
+        for name in OBS.PINS:
+            tree = ast.parse((ROOT / OBS.OWNER / name).read_bytes())
+            for node in tree.body:
+                if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
+                    imports = [alias.name for alias in node.names] if isinstance(node, ast.Import) else [node.module]
+                    self.assertTrue(set(imports) <= allowed_imports)
+                elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
+                    calls = [ast.unparse(c.func) for c in ast.walk(node.value) if isinstance(c, ast.Call)]
+                    self.assertTrue(set(calls) <= {'dict', 'Path'}, (name, calls))
+                elif isinstance(node, ast.If):
+                    self.assertEqual(ast.unparse(node.test), "__name__ == '__main__'")
+                elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
+                    self.assertFalse(node.decorator_list)
+                    self.assertTrue(all(isinstance(n, ast.Pass) for n in node.body))
+                elif isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
+                    self.assertFalse(node.decorator_list)
+                    self.assertFalse(any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) for d in (*node.args.defaults, *filter(None, node.args.kw_defaults)) for n in ast.walk(d)))
+                else:
+                    self.assertIsInstance(node, ast.Expr)
+                    self.assertIsInstance(node.value, ast.Constant)
+
+    def test_direct_owner_entry_points_only(self):
+        tree = ast.parse(PATH.read_bytes())
+        calls = {ast.unparse(n.func) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
+                 and ast.unparse(n.func).startswith(('adapter.', 'native.', 'utility.'))}
+        self.assertEqual(calls, {'adapter.load_utility', 'adapter.load_native', 'adapter.inventory',
+                                 'native.E.encode', 'native.C.target_host'})
+
+    def test_TEST_ONLY_changed_source_refuses_without_execution(self):
+        raw = (ROOT / OBS.OWNER / 'run.py').read_bytes()
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(OBS.Refusal, '^OWNER_SOURCE_PIN_REFUSED$'):
+            OBS.verify_pin('run.py', raw + b'\n# TEST_ONLY mutation; never executed\n')
+
+    def test_TEST_ONLY_provider_shape_and_refusals(self):
+        # Pure validator inputs only. These are never installed into os.environ.
+        env = dict(GITHUB_REPOSITORY=OBS.REPOSITORY, GITHUB_REF='refs/heads/' + OBS.BRANCH,
+                   GITHUB_SHA='1' * 40, GITHUB_RUN_ID='1', GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT='1',
+                   GITHUB_EVENT_NAME='push', GITHUB_ACTIONS='true',
+                   G221_PUSH_CREATED='true', G221_PUSH_DELETED='false')
+        OBS.require_provider(OBS.provider_fields(env), env)
+        for key, value in [('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', 'TEST_ONLY/other'), ('GITHUB_REF', 'refs/heads/TEST_ONLY'),
+                           ('GITHUB_SHA', 'TEST_ONLY'), ('GITHUB_RUN_ID', '0'), ('GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT', '2'),
+                           ('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME', 'workflow_dispatch'), ('GITHUB_ACTIONS', 'false'),
+                           ('G221_PUSH_CREATED', 'false'), ('G221_PUSH_DELETED', 'true')]:
+            changed = dict(env, **{key: value})
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OBS.Refusal, '^PROVIDER_CONTEXT_REFUSED$'):
+                OBS.require_provider(OBS.provider_fields(changed), changed)
+
+    def test_TEST_ONLY_environment_allowlist(self):
+        value = OBS.provider_fields({'GITHUB_TOKEN': 'TEST_ONLY_UNRELATED_VALUE', 'GITHUB_REF': 'TEST_ONLY\nVALUE'})
+        self.assertEqual(set(value), {'repository', 'ref', 'sha', 'run_id', 'attempt', 'event'})
+        self.assertTrue(all(v is None for v in value.values()))
+
+    def test_TEST_ONLY_effect_boundary(self):
+        for event in ('subprocess.Popen', 'socket.__new__', 'os.system', 'os.exec', 'os.fork',
+                      'os.mkdir', 'os.remove', 'os.rename', 'os.chmod', 'os.putenv'):
+            self.assertTrue(OBS.effect_denied(event, ()), event)
+        self.assertTrue(OBS.effect_denied('open', ('/TEST_ONLY/output', 'w', os.O_WRONLY)))
+        self.assertTrue(OBS.effect_denied('open', ('/TEST_ONLY/output', None, os.O_CREAT)))
+        self.assertFalse(OBS.effect_denied('open', ('/TEST_ONLY/input', 'r', os.O_RDONLY)))
+
+    def test_TEST_ONLY_exception_text_withheld(self):
+        value = OBS.failure(PermissionError(13, 'TEST_ONLY_PRIVATE_VALUE', '/TEST_ONLY/private'), 'TEST_ONLY')
+        self.assertEqual(value['code'], 'OBSERVATION_EXCEPTION_REFUSED')
+        self.assertEqual(value['errno'], 13)
+        self.assertNotIn('PRIVATE_VALUE', OBS.canonical(value).decode())
+        self.assertNotIn('/TEST_ONLY/private', OBS.canonical(value).decode())
+
+    def test_workflow_bounds_pin_and_bootstrap_syntax(self):
+        workflow = (ROOT / OBS.WORKFLOW).read_text()
+        self.assertIn("expected = '" + OBS.descriptor(PATH.read_bytes())['sha256'] + "'", workflow)
+        for value in (OBS.BRANCH, "github.event.created == true", "github.event.deleted == false",
+                      "github.run_attempt == '1'", 'contents: read', 'runs-on: ubuntu-26.04',
+                      'persist-credentials: false', 'if: always()', '/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B',
+                      'actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262',
+                      'actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02'):
+            self.assertIn(value, workflow)
+        self.assertEqual(workflow.count('uses:'), 2)
+        self.assertNotIn('workflow_dispatch:', workflow)
+        bootstrap = textwrap.dedent(workflow.split("<<'PY'\n", 1)[1].split('          PY\n', 1)[0])
+        compile(bootstrap, '<TEST_ONLY_workflow_bootstrap_syntax>', 'exec')

+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
